name: Face primer

lead: Face primer is a cream applied before other makeup to improve coverage and help it last. It gives makeup a smoother base, which can make skin look more even.
The effect lasts as long as the makeup is worn. Types include foundation, eyelid, under-eye and lip primers, and mattifying primers aimed at shine.

paras: Applied after skincare and before foundation or concealer. People choose by purpose, for example mattifying for oily skin or a moisturising formula, and some products contain SPF or tint.
Ingredients vary, including silicones, salicylic acid and fragrance, and some people react to individual ingredients. Some formulas omit oil, fragrance or preservatives.

chain: Makeup sits more evenly and wears longer
angle.text: Primer is used to make foundation and concealer look smoother and last, which gives an even-looking complexion while worn.[1]

lead: A cosmetic primer is a cream applied before other makeup to improve coverage and extend wear.[1] Face primers are used to create a smoother base that helps makeup last longer and resist creasing or sliding.[1]

Variants include foundation primers, eyelid primers that even tone and hold shadow, under-eye primers for use before concealer, lip primers that reduce feathering, and mascara primers.[1] Mattifying versions are aimed at shine and oil.[1]
Wikipedia notes that its coverage rests mostly on retailer and beauty-blog sources rather than published studies.[1]

paras: Foundation primers may moisturise or absorb oil for a matte finish.[1] Under-eye primers are formulated for delicate skin and used before concealer.[1]

Common ingredients include salicylic acid for oil absorption, vitamins A, C and E and plant extracts as antioxidants, silicones such as cyclomethicone and dimethicone, and minerals such as mica and silica.[1]
